breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly resolves the inconsistency by dropping the given W2=100 m/s and instead computing the axial velocity from inlet conditions (Va = W1 cos(beta1)) and then deriving W2 from the constant axial velocity and beta2 (W2 = Va / cos(beta2)). This matches the ground truth approach and ensures the axial velocity is truly constant through the rotor.
